What the code contains: `P-01M6BJ171M7QMMEEDDQH6SVZYJ` is a Python project with 6 module(s), a command line (`client.py`, `server.py`) and 1 test file(s).
Summary of the code: This repository implements a simple TCP chat system using only the Python standard library. The client program (client.py) reads lines from stdin, sends them to the server, and prints any messages received, while the server (server.py) runs a multi‑client TCP chat server that broadcasts each client’s messages to all others, handling each connection in its own thread. The wire format is defined in protocol.py, which specifies UTF‑8 text lines terminated by "\n" and enforces a maximum line length. The package’s interfaces, chat/client_interface.py::ChatClientInterface and chat/server_interface.py::ChatServerInterface, expose send/receive/close and start/stop/client_count/broadcast methods respectively, tying the command‑line tools to the underlying networking logic.
Declared dependencies: only the standard library
Entry points: client.py, server.py, test_chat.py

response.text: {"what":"This project provides a simple TCP chat system that lets multiple users exchange messages in real time. It includes a client program for sending and receiving chat lines and a server that manages connections and broadcasts messages to all participants. The design is lightweight and relies solely on the Python standard library, making it easy to run and extend. It is ideal for developers or learners who want a clear example of networked communication without external dependencies."}
